parameters.query: SELECT r.full_name as referrer_name, r.college, r.referral_code, COUNT(s.id) as confirmed_referrals FROM public.registrations r JOIN public.registrations s ON s.referred_by_code = r.referral_code WHERE s.status = 'confirmed' AND r.status = 'confirmed' GROUP BY r.id, r.full_name, r.college, r.referral_code ORDER BY confirmed_referrals DESC LIMIT 15;
